objects: one physical normal-layout permanent card with one ordinary printed fixed-mana Morph descriptor
one face-down creature spell and the same resulting permanent
events: cast a card face down using Morph
turn the permanent face up as a special action
costs: one fixed ordinary mana Morph cost
timing: turn face up any time its controller has priority
turn face up does not use the stack
choices: select the normal or face-down cast offer
select automatic or explicit canonical mana payment
hidden_information: only the controller's authorized view sees the face-down identity
other seats see one stable face-down stack or battlefield object
turning face up and battlefield or stack departure reveal the identity to every seat
apnap: ordinary multiplayer priority passing governs face-down spell resolution; the special action itself creates no APNAP ordering or response window
layers: the Morph face-down effect applies in copy layer 1b after copy values
would-be-face-up eligibility removes only that layer-1b effect and still applies represented later layers
face-down static sources do not participate
replacement_effects: represented cast cost and zone-transition replacements remain in their canonical owners
the turn-face-up action itself is not a zone change or replacement event
copy: card copies, spell copies, copied values, and granted Morph are excluded
control_change: only the current controller receives the turn-face-up action and controller knowledge
a former controller retains already known identity without retaining action authority
zone_change: the face-down marker survives only stack to battlefield
any other zone transition creates a face-up destination incarnation and reveals a departing battlefield or stack object
source_leaves: a countered or otherwise departing face-down spell is revealed and loses the method marker
a departing face-down permanent is revealed and the returned object cannot use the old action

variants: ordinary fixed colored and generic Morph costs
noncreature permanent cards cast as face-down creatures

implementation.component: FixedManaMorphSpec, fixed_mana_morph_keyword_node, FixedManaMorphHandler, compiled_fixed_mana_morph_spec, casting proposal/commit, face-down characteristic evaluation, morph special-action owner, zone-object state, priority, projection, and replay
implementation.supported_slice: One printed normal-layout permanent card with exactly one fixed ordinary-mana Morph ability, complete current CardProgram trust, no copied values, and no unsupported turn-face-up behavior.

known_blockers: Megamorph, Disguise, Manifest, Cloak, and other face-down methods
variable, hybrid, Phyrexian, snow, and nonmana Morph costs
copied, granted, text-changed, and dynamically added Morph
card copies, spell copies, tokens, multiface cards, and merged permanents
turn-face-up triggers or replacement abilities on residual CardPrograms
arbitrary static component ability addition and removal until one shared applicability query exists
dynamic characteristic counts and affected copy or type-changing interactions
aggregate Morph and CR 708 coverage remain incomplete
